description: Read your Google Health data from any agent: data points for every Google Health data type (heart rate, sleep, steps, distance, weight, blood oxygen, VO2 max, exercise and more), server-side daily roll-ups, a parsed view of exercise sessions, and GET of any read-only v4 API path, all as JSON. `data list`, `rollup daily`, `sessions --raw` and `api get` return every record the API sends for the window you ask for, unfiltered; the parsed `sessions` view leaves out points it can't date and reports how many on stderr. It never writes to Google Health; the only file it writes is its own local OAuth token cache. Also ships auth login/logout/status, doctor, config show/path, version and shell completion. Single static Go binary. Needs your own Google Cloud OAuth client and a one-time browser login; runs headless afterward.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent execute the browser workflow deterministically with explicit checkpoints?
Did the agent verify final browser state with concrete evidence?
